messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

function.name: distance_calculate
function.description: Calculate the distance between two geographical points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

from_lat.description: The latitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

from_long.description: The longitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

to_lat.description: The latitude of the end point. This is a float type value.

to_long.description: The longitude of the end point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit for distance calculation, 'miles' or 'kilometers'. Default is 'miles'.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code |
|---------|--------------|-----------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger traffic and serve as major hubs for both domestic and international flights.
message.reasoning: User wants major airports in US. Provide list. No tool needed.
